designations.eng: Minimum measured quantity of a measuring system
designations.fra: Quantité mesurée minimale d'un ensemble de mesurage

eng: Minimum measured quantity of a measuring system

terms.designation: Minimum measured quantity of a measuring system

definitions.content: Smallest mass of gas for which the measurement is metrologically acceptable for that system.

notes.content: This smallest mass is also referred to as the minimum delivery.

terms.designation: Quantité mesurée minimale d'un ensemble de mesurage

definitions.content: Plus petite masse de gaz dont le mesurage soit métrologiquement admissible pour cet ensemble.

notes.content: Cette plus petite masse de gaz est aussi appelée livraison minimale
